name: ailoy
description: Build an AI agent in Python, Node.js or Rust, with a Linux micro-VM of its own to run code in.

interface.shortDescription: AI agent builder with a VM at its heart
interface.longDescription: Ailoy is a library for building AI agents in Python, Node.js and Rust. An agent drives a language model through tool-augmented turns, and each agent can own a Linux micro-VM to work in: it installs software, writes and runs code, and keeps files there, touching the host only through the folders you mount. Tools come from the built-in set, from any MCP server, from your own functions and from skill directories you write, and the GPU reaches into the VM for models and games.
capabilities: Build an agent with one builder call in Python, Node.js or Rust
Give each agent a Linux micro-VM booted from an image you declare
Mount only the host folders the agent may read or write
Use the tools of any MCP server, stdio or streamable HTTP
Register your own functions and skill directories as tools
Run on any provider by naming the model, with the key from the environment
